user.title: Real persons
user.description: Real persons are the people whose presence decides whether somebody is at home who is not a virtual tracker. Home Assistant has to be able to locate them on its own, so each of them needs a device tracker.

data_description.persons: At least one person is required. Suggested are the persons that currently have a device tracker; a person without one is usually the person a virtual tracker is meant for.

reconfigure.title: Real persons
reconfigure.description: Change the people whose presence decides whether somebody is at home who is not a virtual tracker. Home Assistant has to be able to locate them on its own, so each of them needs a device tracker.

data_description.persons: At least one person is required. Do not add a person that a virtual tracker is assigned to: switching that tracker on would look like a real arrival.

error.no_persons: Select at least one real person.
error.person_has_virtual_tracker: A virtual tracker of this integration is attached to {persons}. Switching that tracker on would look like a real person coming home and reset every virtual tracker, so pick somebody else.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. Only a single configuration is possible.

user.title: Add a virtual tracker
user.description: A virtual tracker stands in for a household member without a phone, for example a child, a grandparent or a guest. Assign it to a person of its own afterwards, and that person counts as being at home for as long as the tracker is switched on.

data.name: Name
data.reset_on_return: Reset when a real person comes home
data.ask_on_departure: Ask when the house becomes empty

data_description.name: Used for the entities of this tracker, for example the name of the child or guest it stands for.
data_description.reset_on_return: Switches the tracker off again as soon as the first real person enters the empty house, so that it cannot stay switched on for days.
data_description.ask_on_departure: Opens a prompt when the last real person leaves and this tracker is off. The prompt is always announced by the tracker's event entity and can be answered with the action "Answer prompt"; pick recipients below to have it sent to their phones as well.
data_description.answer_timeout: How long the prompt stays open, in minutes. Without an answer nothing changes and the house counts as empty.
data_description.prompt_delay: How long to wait after the last real person left before the prompt opens, in seconds. Keep it below the delay of your own "nobody home" automations.
data_description.notify_persons: The real persons whose Home Assistant Companion App receives the question, with a Yes and a No button. Everyone who is asked needs the app signed in with their own user account; the first answer counts and takes the message off the other phones. Leave empty to send nothing at all and deliver the prompt with an automation of your own.
data_description.notify_on_expiry: Sends a short note to the same phones when nobody answered in time. Nothing is sent when somebody answers or when the prompt is withdrawn.

reconfigure.title: Edit the virtual tracker
reconfigure.description: Rename the tracker or change when it is reset and when it asks. Renaming is safe: the entities of the tracker keep their identity.

error.name_exists: A tracker with this name already exists.

no_open_prompt.message: There is no open prompt for {entity_id}, so there is nothing to answer.

prompt_already_open.message: There is already an open prompt for {entity_id}, so there is nothing to ask again.

tracker_already_home.message: {entity_id} is already switched on, so there is nobody to ask about.

no_tracker.title: No virtual tracker has been added yet
no_tracker.description:
Virtual Presence Tracker is set up, but there is no virtual tracker yet, so nothing happens. A virtual tracker stands in for a household member without a phone, for example a child, a grandparent or a guest.

Add one under Settings > Devices & services > Integrations > Virtual Presence Tracker > "Add virtual tracker". Afterwards assign it to a person of its own, so that person counts as being at home while the tracker is switched on.

tracker_not_assigned.title: The virtual tracker {name} is not assigned to a person
tracker_not_assigned.description:
Nobody counts as being at home when {name} is switched on: the device tracker `{entity_id}` is not part of any person, so Home Assistant has nobody to place at home.

Go to Settings > People, open the person {name} stands for (or add one, no login needed) and pick `{entity_id}` in the list of device trackers of that person. If you do not need the tracker any more, delete it in Settings > Devices & services > Virtual Presence Tracker.

real_person_has_virtual_tracker.title: The real person {person} has a virtual tracker attached
real_person_has_virtual_tracker.description:
{person} is one of the real persons of Virtual Presence Tracker, and the virtual tracker `{tracker}` is attached to that person. Switching that tracker on therefore looks like a real person coming home, which switches every virtual tracker off again.

Fix it in one of two ways: remove `{tracker}` from {person} in Settings > People, or take {person} out of the real persons in Settings > Devices & services > Virtual Presence Tracker > Reconfigure.

recipient_without_phone.title: {person} has no phone to be asked on
recipient_without_phone.description:
{person} is set to be asked about {tracker} when the house becomes empty, but Home Assistant has no phone to send the question to: no Home Assistant Companion App is registered for the user account of {person}.

Install the Companion App on that person's phone and sign in with their own user account (Settings > People shows which user a person belongs to), or take {person} out of "Who is asked?" under Settings > Devices & services > Virtual Presence Tracker > Edit virtual tracker. The prompt itself still works: it is announced by the tracker's event entity and can be answered with the action "Answer prompt".

real_person_missing.title: The real person {person} no longer exists
real_person_missing.description:
{person} is configured as a real person of Virtual Presence Tracker, but that entity is gone - deleted or renamed. Its presence is no longer taken into account, so virtual trackers may not reset any more when somebody comes home.

Select your real persons again in Settings > Devices & services > Virtual Presence Tracker > Reconfigure.

answer_prompt.name: Answer prompt
answer_prompt.description: Answers the open prompt of a virtual tracker. "Yes" switches the tracker on, "no" leaves everything as it is.

answer.name: Answer
answer.description: Whether the person the tracker stands for is at home.

answered_by.name: Answered by
answered_by.description: The person who gave the answer. Only passed on to the tracker's event entity, for automations that want to know who replied.

open_prompt.name: Open prompt
open_prompt.description: Opens the prompt of a virtual tracker right now, without waiting for the last real person to leave. It ignores who is at home, the tracker's "Ask when the house becomes empty" option and the delay; everything after that is the usual prompt, including the notification and the time to answer.
